$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the captured pipeline with the whole evaluation job removed, which is what a run writes when it never detects ci/evaluation-ci-plan.json. The request says the repository holds an evaluation and never names the plan, so a run that skips the detection step writes the test job and nothing else.
Every other element is the capture's, so the result is that one deviation.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean and keeps the five elements the request states outright. Neither evaluation command is invoked by any run: block and no upload-artifact step names runs/, so three elements miss. Nothing unrequested was added.

elementMisses: command-evaluation-check: no run: block invokes npx tea-evaluate check --evaluation evals/grader
command-evaluation-ci-pr: no run: block invokes npx tea-evaluate ci --evaluation evals/grader --tier pr
artifact-evaluation-runs: no upload-artifact step names a path containing runs/
